quests.title: One post, standing on its own
quests.ask: Write `build_post()`: starting at the foot of a post facing east, stack the whole post, then end back at its foot, facing east again.
quests.nudge: After the post is built, which way is the robot looking? The next part expects east.

quests.title: Walk to the next post
quests.ask: Write `next_post()`: from the foot of one post, walk along the ground to the foot of the next one, leaving the gap between them empty.
quests.nudge: Count the cells on the picture: where does the next post stand?

quests.title: The whole fence
quests.ask: Now the plan: use your two names to build every post of the fence.
quests.nudge: Look at the Goal view. How many times does the plan need to run?
